name: Sprite Socket Bench
runtime: Extract ZIP and open index.html in a modern desktop browser
input: PNG frames or equal-cell PNG sprite sheet without margins or gaps
does_not_include: reader support for rotation or multiple clips
privacy: Product processes images locally with no network requests
ai_disclosure: Developed with AI assistance; no generative model runs in the product

editing_safety.recovery: Best-effort same-tab applied-data snapshot; last valid snapshot retained on invalid input/storage failure
editing_safety.durable_backup: Use Save project, verify downloaded file, then Confirm file saved

godot_reader_license: Full licensed users may embed, modify and distribute the reader in their own commercial games/apps; editor and standalone reader redistribution prohibited
